Temperature/Humidity Weather Station with 7 Inch Colour Display

CAT.NO: XC0416

$74.95 $149.00

Overview

This unit features a 7" diagonal (165 x 90mm) colour display with a big digit which can be easily read from across the room, and super bright backlight.

A compact remote humidity/temperature sensor is provided which transmits info to up to 30 metres away and the unit can support up to 8 x XC0417 sensors at one time, allowing you to monitor multiple rooms, garage or pantry. Display includes indoor and outdoor temperature/humidity.
